data.name: Get Endpoint Request Error Rate Metric
data.description: Can request specific fields by enabling the `fields` query param
data.evaluateGuide: Retrieves the WhatsApp Flow endpoint error-rate metric for a lifetime or date range, with selectable response fields. Use for: checking Flow errors, measuring endpoint reliability, reviewing date-range metrics Not supported: sending messages, editing Flows, delivery analytics

data.name: POST Render a search application query
data.evaluateGuide: Submits a search application query to Elasticsearch and returns matching search results. Use for: running application searches, testing search queries, retrieving matching documents Not supported: index creation, document updates, cluster administration

data.name: Query Metric Aggregates
data.description:
Query and aggregate event data associated with a metric, including native Klaviyo metrics, integration-specific metrics, and custom events (not to be confused with custom metrics, which are not supported at this time). Queries must be passed in the JSON body of your POST request.
To request campaign and flow performance data that matches the data shown in Klaviyo's UI, we recommend the [Reporting API](https://developers.klaviyo.co
data.evaluateGuide: Queries and aggregates event data associated with Klaviyo metrics through a JSON payload. Use for: aggregating metric events, analyzing custom events, comparing integration metrics Not supported: custom metric queries, campaign reporting, flow performance reports

data.name: POST listMetrics
data.evaluateGuide: Submits a query to retrieve metric definitions or values from Apache SkyWalking. Use for: listing metrics, discovering available metrics, querying observability data Not supported: trace retrieval, log search, service configuration

data.name: Return Atlas Search Metrics for One Index in One Specified Namespace
data.description: Returns the Atlas Search metrics data series within the provided time range for one namespace and index name on the specified process. You must have the Project Read Only or higher role to view the Atlas Search metric types.
data.evaluateGuide: Returns Atlas Search metric series for one index and namespace within a specified time range. Use for: measuring search queries, checking search errors, analyzing index performance Not supported: index management, document search, cluster configuration

data.name: POST readNullableMetricsValue
data.evaluateGuide: Reads nullable metric values from Apache SkyWalking using the supplied query payload. Use for: retrieving optional metric values, inspecting observability metrics, handling nullable results Not supported: trace retrieval, log search, metric definition management

data.name: Retrieve metrics of SMS delivery errors
data.description: Retrieve the reporting metrics of SMS
data.evaluateGuide: Retrieves SMS delivery-error reporting metrics for a specified date range. Use for: monitoring SMS failures, reviewing delivery errors, analyzing reporting periods Not supported: sending SMS, message content retrieval, recipient management

data.name: POST readLabeledMetricsValues
data.evaluateGuide: Reads labeled metric values from Apache SkyWalking using the supplied query payload. Use for: retrieving labeled metrics, analyzing metric dimensions, inspecting observability data Not supported: trace retrieval, log search, metric creation

data.name: Lists work request errors
data.description: Returns a paginated list of errors for the specified work request.
data.evaluateGuide: Lists errors associated with a specified Oracle Cloud work resource, with pagination and sorting options. Use for: diagnosing work failures, listing processing errors, reviewing error timestamps Not supported: creating work resources, retrying operations, retrieving successful results

data.name: Query Default Permissions (Metrics)
data.description:
Returns details of default permission rules granted to users and groups for metric resources in a project.

Version: Version 2.1 and later. Version 3.23 and later for the virtual connection default permissions methods.
   Versioning Overview


Permissions: Users who are not server administrators can query default permissions for a project only if they have theProjectLeader permission for that project (either
data.evaluateGuide: Returns default permission rules for metric resources in a Tableau project. Use for: auditing metric permissions, reviewing default rules, checking user and group access Not supported: changing permissions, querying metric values, managing projects
